study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter randomized controlled trial
exposure: Institutional protocols for vaginal preparation with antiseptic solution before cesarean delivery
outcome: Superficial or deep surgical site infection
Composite of endometritis, wound infection or other infections
cohort: Women with viable pregnancies undergoing cesarean delivery during labor.
finding: Institutional policies for vaginal preparation before cesarean delivery were not associated with lower rates of surgical site infection or other maternal secondary outcomes in women undergoing cesarean delivery during labor.
mod_finding: Institutional policies for vaginal preparation before cesarean delivery were not associated with lower rates of surgical site infection in women undergoing cesarean delivery.
